name: Finnmark FD-5 Trinity XL 4-Person Hybrid Infrared & Steam Sauna & Red Light
description: Description For those who refuse to compromise, welcome to the pinnacle of home wellness. The Finnmark Trinity XL is the largest and most powerful sauna in the lineup, a true 3-in-1 sanctuary designed for the ultimate sauna experience. It combines three distinct experiences into one magnificent cabin: deep-penetrating infrared, high-heat traditional steam, and red light therapy. Powered by a robust 4.5kW Harvia traditional heater and an advanced infrared system, the Trinity XL is engineered for unparalleled performance. This is the definitive sauna experience, offering unmatched space, power, and versatility for you, your family, and your friends. Three Experiences, Unmatched Power The Trinity XL allows you to tailor your session to your exact needs, offering three distinct experiences in one spacious cabin. For Deep, Penetrating Warmth (Infrared): Immerse yourself in a room filled with deep, penetrating warmth from the UL-listed Spectrum Plus™ infrared heaters. This is a dry heat (up to 170°F) for a deep, relaxing sweat. For an Authentic Finnish Experience (Traditional): Engage the legendary 4.5kW Harvia KIP traditional heater. Ladle water over 50lbs of hot stones to generate powerful waves of invigorating steam, or "löyly." This is the classic, high-heat (up to 194°F) experience for a truly intense sweat. For a Calming Finish (Red Light): Bathe in the warm glow of the Spectrum Red Light™ Therapy panel and its 650nm red light, a calming way to end any session. Pro-Grade Electrical Requirements To deliver its exceptional performance, the Trinity XL requires a professional power setup. Here’s what you need to know: Outlet Needed: This high-performance sauna requires a dedicated 240V, 20A circuit. This is essential for powering both the 4.5kW traditional heater and the advanced infrared system safely and effectively. Why 240V?: Like other professional-grade appliances, this voltage is necessary to heat the large cabin quickly and maintain consistently high temperatures for the best results. Installation: A licensed electrician will need to run the proper wiring and install the correct outlet for the sauna. Premium Features & Construction Antimicrobial Canadian Cedar Interior: The beautiful cedar interior naturally resists mold and bacteria, keeping your sanctuary fresh while providing that classic sauna aroma. Durable Thermal-Treated Exterior: The Thermal Plus™ Aspen exterior is chemically-free and treated to resist warping, rot, or chipping for decades of durability. Intuitive Controls & Premium Sound: A sleek, built-in LCD touchscreen with Bluetooth lets you control your entire experience, while 6" HiFi marine-grade speakers deliver crystal-clear audio. Expansive Two-Tier Bench System: The extra-large, multi-level bench provides ample room for 4-5 people and allows you to sit higher to enjoy the most intense heat. What's Included Sauna Wall, Floor & Ceiling Panels Pre-Hung 8mm Tempered Glass Door Expansive Two-Tier Bench System All Spectrum Plus™ Infrared Heater Panels (1) Harvia KIP 4.5kW Traditional Heater (1) 44lb Box of Premium Harvia Sauna Stones (1) Spectrum Red Light™ Therapy Panel LCD Touchscreen Controller & Bluetooth Audio System Comprehensive Warranty & ETL Certification Specifications Model FD-5 External Materials Thermo-Aspen Interior Materials Western Canadian Cedar Volts 240 IR Watts 2700 Amperage 15 | TBD Plug Type NEMA 5-15P Maximum Temperature IR 170° F | Traditional 190° F Interior Dimensions 71"W x 57.5"D x 75.5"H Exterior Dimensions 75"W x 64"D x 83"H Room Volume 130 cu. ft. Door Dimensions 23.625"W x 68.875"H Door Handle Dimensions 1.5"W x 13.25"H Glass Thickness 8mm W/Gasket Product Weight 575 lbs Shipping Dimensions 36"W x 80"D Shipping Weight 654 lbs W/48 lb Pallet Assembly, Operating Cost & Manual Assembly: The latch-together panel design makes assembly straightforward. Given the size and weight of the panels, we recommend 2-3 people for a safe and easy setup, which typically takes about 2-3 hours. Operating Cost: For its immense power and size, the Trinity XL is very efficient. Infrared Mode: ~30 to 40 cents per hour. Traditional Mode: ~50 to 65 cents per hour. Owner's Manual: You can view the complete owner's manual here: Download Owner's Manual .
